evidence_provenance.optimization: R57 critical two-load LUT output only: unroute selected net, then ordinary timing-driven route_design -preserve without -nets or -directive; preserve other completed routes for that command. Separate final TNS cleanup may change other routes. No auto_delay, custom delay bounds, logic/copy/clock/retime/RTL/XDC/serial-stage changes.

physical_register_audit.scope: Route-only canonical whole functional-simulation netlist text equality (HDL parameters/ports/constants/INIT retained; synthesis/physical attributes omitted), explicit all94 DSP property audit and connectivity audit. Not timing-annotated/SDF simulation, fullRoot formal equivalence, physical CDC or board proof. -preserve applies to target repair route command only, final TNS cleanup may reroute other nets.
